headline: Northern Fronts Surge as Fierce Clashes Grip Nevish Line and Weathered Expanse
war_summary: Combat over the latest operational hours has coalesced into furious clashes along the northern front, led by violent exchanges across Weathered Expanse, Nevish Line, and Mooring County. Weathered Expanse remains the war's bloodiest theater, registering eight tactical events in the past two hours and heavy casualties as contests persist around Wightwalk and outlying positions. In Nevish Line, intense engagements near Grief Mother and Blackcoat Way generated five base shifts in the same span, leaving Wardens holding five strongholds against three Colonial positions. Mooring County continues to witness direct pressure, logging fresh turnover at MacConmara Barrows and Gravekeeper's Holdfast alongside elevated casualty rates on both sides. Meanwhile, Callahan's Passage maintains high casualty tallies near Crumbling Post despite structural shifts pausing over the last two hours. In contrast, earlier turbulent island and coastal sectors in Kuura Strand and Palantine Berm have lapsed into comparative stillness, reporting zero events and negligible casualties in recent hours.
